transcript: Speaker A: Get out from here. Itni basic English bhi nahi aati aur lagta hai naukri mil jayegi. [Get out of here. You don't even know basic English and you think you'll get a job.] Speaker B: Mera naam Neha hai. Main Indore se hoon. Age 23. Pichhle do saal se interviews de rahi thi. Har jagah ek hi problem - English. Skills the, mehnat bhi thi, par jab bhi koi bolta 'tell me about yourself', mera dimaag to blank ho jata tha. Aur us din bhi interview mein wahi hua. Par is baar thoda zyada bura laga. Phir ek din raat ko phone chala rahi thi, tab ek ad dikha SpeakX app ka. Roz sirf 15 minute AI coach ke saath practice karke English seekho. Maine socha try kar leti hoon. Pehle din thoda sa awkward laga. Main to Hindi mein bolti thi, par AI coach Sia use turant sahi English mein convert karti thi. Main galti karti thi, wo bina judge kiye correct karti thi. Roz sirf 10 se 15 minute, bas itna hi. Pehle week basic sentences seekhe, doosre week thoda confidence aane laga. Ek mahine baad to main rukti nahi thi. Pehli baar laga main bhi bol sakti hoon. Is baar interview hua, phir se same question - 'Tell me about yourself'. Par is baar main nahi ruki. 'Good morning ma'am, my name is Neha. I have two years of experience.' Is baar main select ho gayi. Salary double, confidence usse bhi zyada. Sirf 15 minute jo pehle reels mein waste hote the, unhone meri life change kar di. Agar tum bhi 'Tell me about yourself' pe blank ho jaate ho, to SpeakX app download karo. Roz 15 minute practice karo aur apni English improve karo. Next interview tumhara ho sakta hai. [My name is Neha. I am from Indore. Age 23. I had been giving interviews for the last two years. Same problem everywhere - English. I had skills, I worked hard, but whenever someone said 'tell me about yourself', my mind would go blank. And that day in the interview, the same thing happened. But this time it felt a bit worse. Then one night I was using my phone, and I saw an ad for the SpeakX app. Learn English by practicing with an AI coach for just 15 minutes daily. I thought I'd try it. On the first day, it felt a bit awkward. I used to speak in Hindi, but AI coach Sia would instantly convert it to correct English. If I made a mistake, she would correct it without judging. Just 10 to 15 minutes daily, that's it. In the first week, I learned basic sentences, in the second week, I started gaining confidence. After a month, I wouldn't stop. For the first time, I felt I could speak too. This time the interview happened, same question again - 'Tell me about yourself'. But this time I didn't stop. 'Good morning ma'am, my name is Neha. I have two years of experience.' This time I got selected. Salary doubled, confidence even more. Just 15 minutes that used to be wasted on reels changed my life. If you also go blank on 'Tell me about yourself', download the SpeakX app. Practice 15 minutes daily and improve your English. The next interview could be yours.]
